scope: sampled composable local boundary responses; complete singleton graph; exact finite regions only

library.scope: finite input traces from fresh local solutions; no complete boundary relation or infinite extension claim

configuration.macro_execution: conditional ordered proposal; interrupt before any unscheduled move; retain every singleton

timing_provenance: single sequential fresh process; universe, donor, mining, atlas validation/compilation and policy costs separate; process peak is not per-lane allocation

independent_audit.scope: all saved moves and local composition laws; no full global boundary relation, infinite extension, or exhausted heuristic proof

semantic_tests.scope: complete research suite; finite point-domain, local response composition, scheduler, exact rollback and declared request-controller checks
